description: Inspect files and projects on This device directly, without SSH. List directories, read text, and run local shell commands.

function.name: list_directory
function.description: List files and directories on this device, without SSH.

path.description: Local directory; relative paths and omission use the dedicated agent workspace.

limit.description: Optional requested result size; omitted or 0 returns all.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a complete local text file by default, or request a byte range. Returns next_offset and truncated; use local_exec for binary inspection.

path.description: Local text file; relative paths use the agent workspace.

max_bytes.description: Optional requested result size; omitted or 0 returns all.

refresh.description: Read again even if this unchanged range has already been read in this turn.

function.name: read_files
function.description: Read independent local files together in one call. Prefer this to repeated read_file calls. Each file supports the same path, byte range and refresh options as read_file. Returns a result or error for each file.

path.description: Local text file; relative paths use the agent workspace.

max_bytes.description: Optional requested result size; omitted or 0 returns all.

refresh.description: Read again even if this unchanged range has already been read in this turn.

function.name: local_exec
function.description: Run a local shell command. Android uses /system/bin/sh; desktop uses /bin/sh in the shared uv environment. YOLO runs it automatically; Approve asks the user first. Defaults to the agent workspace. No Pilon execution deadline or output cap; Stop cancels the command. Inspect before modifying user files and verify results. Input is closed (EOF); use noninteractive commands, explicit filenames, or a heredoc/pipe for input.

command.description: Shell command scoped to the requested task.

working_directory.description: Explicit directory; defaults to agent workspace. Relative directories resolve there. Each call starts fresh.
